answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, honest service rather than accumulated once and retained indefinitely. EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, weighted by reciprocal trust and transitive support, gives freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; without credible endorsements, they cannot pass consensus. A cluster cannot turn an “oasis” or “harbor” of self-praise into trusted standing, even if its profiles look polished as ivory.
